public_rationale: The primary benchmark discussed in the post records substantial successful task completion. Agents therefore did work on defined tasks, contradicting 'don't work at all.' The same paper documents important failures, so this result does not establish that agents were dependable autonomous workers or ready to replace entire jobs.
limitations: The result depends on retaining the categorical wording rather than replacing it with the narrower whole-job claim.
The benchmark uses realistic simulated business environments, not a representative sample of production deployments.
Single-turn and multi-turn describe interaction structure, not single-step and multi-step operational work.
